notes: Real upstream clone (syncthing/syncthing) debugging task, deliberately raised difficulty: no reproduction is provided, the agent must localise the bug in a large unfamiliar Go codebase, write its own failing reproduction as a deliverable, and fix the mechanism (add an OptFollow open flag through the filesystem abstraction: lib/fs/filesystem.go, lib/fs/basicfs.go, lib/fs/basicfs_unix.go, lib/fs/basicfs_windows.go, lib/ignore/ignore.go). The verifier runs the agent's repro against both the repaired tree and a pristine pre-fix tree, the upstream regression test planted from the fix commit, the project's own full lib/ignore and lib/fs suites, and three authored hidden cases (symlink target in a subdirectory, target outside the folder via a '..' link, and a direct lib/fs test of the OptFollow flag). Single-CPU sandbox; Go module compress at 1 CPU are minutes, which is folded into the agent and verifier timeouts. Rubric total 12 -> medium.
